{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Remove rows with biomarker_baseline == -999 (QC failure)
df_clean = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq for each patient
df_dedup = df_clean.loc[df_clean.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 3: Compute the mean of biomarker_baseline (already in ng/mL, no batch correction needed)
mean_baseline = df_dedup['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print all required numbers
print(f"Number of rows excluded due to biomarker_baseline == -999: {len(df) - len(df_clean)}")
print(f"Number of patients after deduplication: {len(df_dedup)}")
print(f"Mean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL): {mean_baseline}")"}
